title: Free Holland Career Interest Test (RIASEC) | FermatMind
description: Explore six RIASEC career-interest dimensions with a free Holland Code test. Choose 60 questions (about 8 minutes) or 140 questions (about 18 minutes). Interests are not aptitude or guaranteed career fit.

payload_json.hero_copy: Explore six career-interest dimensions. Choose 60 questions (about 8 minutes) or 140 questions (about 18 minutes). The 140-question form is more contextual, not more accurate; raw scores are not directly comparable. This test does not measure aptitude, ability, personality, hiring suitability, or guaranteed career fit.
